profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead at Raptor Technologies
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced PHP developer, with a proven track record of delivering robust, reliable and scalable software. 

I have 10 years of B2B SaaS experience, handling high volumes of traffic and data in the construction and education sectors. In both these environments, an emphasis on delivering a reliable and accurate product has been essential.

I enjoy developing an architecture that allows for consistent results, including reusable and testable business logic.

My primary skillset includes:
- PHP
- Laravel
- MySQL
- JavaScript
- CSS
- Git

Additional Skills
- Docker
- AWS Task Definitions and Deployments
- Jira / Confluence
